question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Plausible’ from the given sentence.

The trend of improvement is unlikely to continue for the foreseeable future.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plausible"** means something** that appears to be reasonable or probable. **(सम्भाव्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Her explanation seemed **plausible**, so we believed her.
 
 
 
• **"Unlikely"** refers to something **that is not probable or expected to happen.** (असंभव)
 
 
• **Example: **It is** unlikely **that it will rain today.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Plausible'** is **'Unlikely'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trend** (प्रवृत्ति): A general direction in which something is developing or changing.

 
 
• **Example:** The** trend **of remote work has increased significantly.
 
 
 
• **Foreseeable** (पूर्वानुमेय): Able to be foreseen or predicted.
 
 
• **Example: **We don't expect any changes in the **foreseeable** future.
 
 
 
• **Future** (भविष्य): The time yet to come.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to plan for the **future.**
